method: 3 sample-only replays supply CPU weights; matched counted replays supply CFG/exact block and branch counts. Join by guest PC plus instruction addresses/opcodes. Rank pooled exclusive innermost natural-loop or measured two-block-cycle samples. CPU milliseconds are each run thread-CPU clock scaled by its sample share.
